runtime_scope: Test-only local loopback Anvil. The miner does not link, load, or ship this binary.

enforced: Archive bytes are downloaded over HTTPS from the pinned upstream release asset URL.
The SHA-256 digest is pinned in this inventory and recomputed after download before extraction.
The extracted binary must be an x86-64 ELF executable, must report the pinned Anvil version, and must report the pinned upstream source commit in its version banner.
The workflow runs Anvil only on 127.0.0.1 with a loopback RPC fixture and no public RPC endpoint.
not_enforced: The upstream Sigstore attestation and any GPG signature are recorded but not verified by the workflow.
This inventory does not independently audit the upstream Foundry source tree.
